title: Our Artworks
body:
## Network as Infrastructure: An Alternative History of Community Technology (2026)

A genealogy of community-owned communication infrastructures, tracing how Black, anti-colonial and grassroots traditions have imagined connection as a shared cultural practice.

Concept by Future Inventions + Designed by Laurent Yee

## Shape Shifter (2026)

An interactive work that moves with you, mimicking how dance is both innate knowledge and transmitted through gathering/learning from one another.

Designed by Future Inventions

![](/images/uploads/img_1160.jpg "Lex demonstrating how to play with Shape Shifter at the Creative Intelligence Festival, Southbank Centre")
